sentences.text: Oceanosuchus was a marine crocodylomorph belonging to the family Pholidosauridae.
It possessed a skull rostrum that was relatively short compared to other members of its family.
Fossils of Oceanosuchus include a skull and partial skeleton discovered in early Cenomanian rocks in Normandy, France.
The genus Oceanosuchus was formally described in 2007 by Hua and colleagues.
Oceanosuchus lived during the Cenomanian stage, approximately 100.5 to 93.9 million years ago.
